author: Isaiaskagames
quote:
This game introduced the foundational concepts of what an open world should be, along with modern gameplay mechanics—all at a time when there were no 3D benchmarks to draw from. I would call it the primitive "initial substance" of 3D gaming. The story is fascinating, and it’s a blast from start to finish. And yes, it’s a game recommended for all ages; children, teenagers, and adults alike will surely hold this game in their hearts forever.
I wish today’s gaming industry would continue to create games like this—games that offer pure fun without resorting to violence or gore.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Isaiaskagames
quote: Im isaias, im from Brazil....Back in the days when I frequented video game rental shops, I didn’t have much exposure to the Nintendo 64. I did play the N64 *Zelda* quite a few times, but I never really delved deep into it—partly because, in Brazil, the cartridges were original imports and weren’t translated. Some time later, around 2008, I finally got to play a translated version. Only now have I truly grasped what all the talk is about and why this game is so exceptional. I’m currently playing it—having purchased an original copy and a Switch—and I’m experiencing something I’ve never felt before. Now, everything makes sense. I finally understand why this brilliantly crafted title is the greatest game ever made.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
